Entry auction: each epoch sells 100 identity slots by sealed bid, bonded 3 epochs. The clearing price is the entry cost: an honest agent pays once, a sybil farmer must outbid itself per clone.
Each identity gets a cipher key, and its first tasks carry a quill audit stamp, so one bid cannot be reused across clones. A vertex scan flags clusters sharing one funding source; duplicates lose their bids.
At 60 units clearing, 1000 sybils cost 60,000.
